item.title: Mirai Senki Slavenil
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Stargazer
  • 発売日: 2013-11-29
  • スコア: 6.65/10 (51 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 未来戦姫スレイブニル
  • 英語名: Mirai Senki Slavenil

あらすじ

This is STARGAZER’s debut title. Katana had a dream one day: he was the ultimate ruler on a giant battleship floating in space, meeting his loyal and admiring subjects. This moment of unspeakable bliss was shattered by a sharp pain in his chest. He saw blood when he put his hand to his chest and wondered if he was going to die. Even though he knew it was a dream, he felt extreme loss and sadness as he fell… into the arms of a naked girl. She told him that even though this was just a dream, it could happen at a later time and that she would protect him.
